## Appearance

Paul Irving has features of exquisite delicacy and refinement framed by a mop of chestnut brown curls. He possesses big, beautiful, and very dark blue eyes that often carry a serious expression.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P27](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0027), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030)_

## Personality

Paul Irving is an imaginative and fair-minded child who possesses a genius intellect along with occasional flashes of uncanny insight. Described as a perfect little gentleman, he keeps himself cleanly and washes his face every day of his own accord. He is also very manly and capable of holding his own in all games.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P54](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0054)_

## History

Paul Irving was an imaginative boy whose mother died three years before he met his teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). On Anne's first day of school, Paul bonded with her and walked home with her, gifting her orchids. Throughout his school days, Paul shared his deep imagination with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), writing compositions about his fictional shore friends and confiding his thoughts about his deceased mother. He formed a special connection with Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), bonding with her over her imaginary dream-boy during visits to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). When Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), returned to the area, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helped reunite him with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), leading to their eventual wedding.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), +346 more_

## Quotes

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

> "He knows I won’t associate with him if he doesn’t. He is really full of wickedness, I think."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P14](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0014)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--paul-irving.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Paul Irving's beloved school teacher, and the two share a deep, lasting friendship built on a mutual love of imagination. They frequently walk together, share tea, and discuss school and Paul's creative thoughts.
